package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type contextSummaryStore struct {
	mu            sync.Mutex
	items         map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary
	invalidations int
	storeCalls    int
	storeErr      error
}

func (store *contextSummaryStore) Latest(_ context.Context, scope domain.TeacherContextScope) (domain.TeacherContextSummary, bool, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item, found := store.items[scope]
	return item, found, nil
}

func (store *contextSummaryStore) Store(_ context.Context, update domain.TeacherContextSummaryUpdate) (domain.TeacherContextSummary, bool, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	store.storeCalls++
	if store.storeErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummary{}, false, store.storeErr
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryUpdate(update)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummary{}, false, err
	}
	existing, found := store.items[normalized.Summary.Scope]
	if found {
		if existing.CoveredThroughSequence == normalized.Summary.CoveredThroughSequence &&
			existing.SourceDigest == normalized.Summary.SourceDigest && reflect.DeepEqual(existing.Payload, normalized.Summary.Payload) {
			return existing, false, nil
		}
		if existing.CoveredThroughSequence != normalized.ExpectedThroughSequence ||
			normalized.NewFromSequence <= existing.CoveredThroughSequence {
			return domain.TeacherContextSummary{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherContextSummaryConflict
		}
		normalized.Summary.Revision = existing.Revision + 1
	} else {
		if normalized.ExpectedThroughSequence != 0 {
			return domain.TeacherContextSummary{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherContextSummaryConflict
		}
		normalized.Summary.Revision = 1
	}
	store.items[normalized.Summary.Scope] = normalized.Summary
	return normalized.Summary, true, nil
}

func (store *contextSummaryStore) Invalidate(_ context.Context, scope domain.TeacherContextScope, through int64, _ time.Time) (bool, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item, found := store.items[scope]
	if !found || item.CoveredThroughSequence != through {
		return false, nil
	}
	delete(store.items, scope)
	store.invalidations++
	return true, nil
}

type contextSummarizer struct {
	requests []domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest
	err      error
}

type blockingContextSummarizer struct {
	ready   *sync.WaitGroup
	release <-chan struct{}
	payload domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload
}

func (summarizer blockingContextSummarizer) Summarize(_ context.Context, _ domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest) (domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload, error) {
	summarizer.ready.Done()
	<-summarizer.release
	return summarizer.payload, nil
}

func (summarizer *contextSummarizer) Summarize(_ context.Context, request domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest) (domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload, error) {
	summarizer.requests = append(summarizer.requests, request)
	if summarizer.err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, summarizer.err
	}
	return summaryPayloadForContext(), nil
}

func TestContextBuilderCompactsPrefixAndLeavesExactRecentTail(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}}
	summarizer := &contextSummarizer{}
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 32)
	builder := ContextBuilder{Summaries: store, Summarizer: summarizer}

	result, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, summarizer.requests, 1)
	require.Len(t, summarizer.requests[0].Messages, 13)
	require.Equal(t, int64(13), summarizer.requests[0].Messages[12].MessageSequence)
	require.NotNil(t, result.ProvisionalSummary)
	require.Equal(t, int64(13), result.ProvisionalSummary.CoveredThroughSequence)
	require.Len(t, result.Messages, 12)
	require.Equal(t, int64(14), result.Messages[0].MessageSequence)
	require.True(t, result.Messages[len(result.Messages)-1].IsSource)
	require.Equal(t, dialog.Messages[len(dialog.Messages)-1].Body, result.Messages[len(result.Messages)-1].Body)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.storeCalls)
}

func TestContextBuilderSummaryFailureUsesBoundedTailWithoutFakeSummary(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}}
	summarizer := &contextSummarizer{err: errors.New("summary unavailable")}
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 2000)

	result, err := (ContextBuilder{Summaries: store, Summarizer: summarizer}).Build(
		context.Background(), dialog, "en", time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, result.ProvisionalSummary)
	require.Empty(t, store.items)
	require.True(t, result.Messages[len(result.Messages)-1].IsSource)
	require.LessOrEqual(t, combinedMessageBytes(result.Messages), domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes)
}

func TestContextBuilderPersistenceFailureUsesTailAndDoesNotExposeUnstoredSummary(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{
		items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}, storeErr: errors.New("database unavailable"),
	}
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 32)
	result, err := (ContextBuilder{Summaries: store, Summarizer: &contextSummarizer{}}).Build(
		context.Background(), dialog, "ru", time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, result.ProvisionalSummary)
	require.True(t, result.Messages[len(result.Messages)-1].IsSource)
	require.Empty(t, store.items)
}

func TestContextBuilderAdvancesMonotonicRangeOnceAndReplayIsStable(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}}
	summarizer := &contextSummarizer{}
	builder := ContextBuilder{Summaries: store, Summarizer: summarizer}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 32)
	_, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for sequence := 26; sequence <= 38; sequence++ {
		appendSourceMessage(&dialog, sequence, 32)
	}
	result, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), result.ProvisionalSummary.CoveredFromSequence)
	require.Equal(t, int64(26), result.ProvisionalSummary.CoveredThroughSequence)
	require.Equal(t, int64(14), summarizer.requests[1].Messages[0].MessageSequence)
	require.NotNil(t, summarizer.requests[1].PriorSummary)
	require.Equal(t, 2, store.storeCalls)

	replayed, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, result, replayed)
	require.Equal(t, 2, store.storeCalls)
	require.Len(t, summarizer.requests, 2)
}

func TestContextBuilderConcurrentSummariesConvergeOnCASWinner(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}}
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 32)
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	var ready sync.WaitGroup
	ready.Add(2)
	release := make(chan struct{})
	firstPayload := summaryPayloadForContext()
	firstPayload.Summary = "first"
	secondPayload := summaryPayloadForContext()
	secondPayload.Summary = "second"
	builders := []ContextBuilder{
		{Summaries: store, Summarizer: blockingContextSummarizer{ready: &ready, release: release, payload: firstPayload}},
		{Summaries: store, Summarizer: blockingContextSummarizer{ready: &ready, release: release, payload: secondPayload}},
	}
	results := make(chan domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext, 2)
	errorsChannel := make(chan error, 2)
	for _, builder := range builders {
		go func(value ContextBuilder) {
			result, err := value.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now)
			results <- result
			errorsChannel <- err
		}(builder)
	}
	ready.Wait()
	close(release)
	first, second := <-results, <-results
	require.NoError(t, <-errorsChannel)
	require.NoError(t, <-errorsChannel)
	require.NotNil(t, first.ProvisionalSummary)
	require.NotNil(t, second.ProvisionalSummary)
	require.Equal(t, first.ProvisionalSummary.Observations, second.ProvisionalSummary.Observations)
	require.Contains(t, []string{"first", "second"}, first.ProvisionalSummary.Observations.Summary)
	require.Equal(t, 2, store.storeCalls)
}

func TestContextBuilderFailsClosedInsteadOfTruncatingSource(t *testing.T) {
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(1, 20)
	dialog.Messages[0].Body = strings.Repeat("я", domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes+1)

	_, err := (ContextBuilder{}).Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", time.Now().UTC())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherContextSourceTooLarge)
}

func TestContextBuilderDropsOldestHistoryDeterministicallyToHardBudgets(t *testing.T) {
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(50, domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes)
	builder := ContextBuilder{}
	first, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", time.Now().UTC())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", time.Now().UTC())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, first, second)
	require.Less(t, len(first.Messages), 50)
	require.Greater(t, first.Messages[0].MessageSequence, int64(1))
	for index := 1; index < len(first.Messages); index++ {
		require.Equal(t, first.Messages[index-1].MessageSequence+1, first.Messages[index].MessageSequence)
	}
	require.True(t, first.Messages[len(first.Messages)-1].IsSource)
	require.LessOrEqual(t, combinedMessageBytes(first.Messages), domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(first)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.LessOrEqual(t, len(encoded), domain.TeacherContextMaximumBytes)
	require.LessOrEqual(t, utf8.RuneCount(encoded), domain.TeacherContextMaximumRunes)
}

func TestContextBuilderFitsLargestValidSummaryAndTailWithinCombinedBudget(t *testing.T) {
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(50, domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes)
	scope, err := domain.NewTeacherContextScope(domain.TeacherContextScope{
		StudentID: dialog.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: dialog.PersonalTeacherID, DialogID: dialog.DialogID,
		ContextType: dialog.ContextType, ContextID: dialog.ContextID,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	large := domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{
		Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: strings.Repeat("я", 4000),
		UnderstoodObservations: repeatedSummaryItems(), OpenDifficulties: repeatedSummaryItems(),
		AssistanceObservations: repeatedSummaryItems(), NextFocus: repeatedSummaryItems(),
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	stored := domain.TeacherContextSummary{
		Scope: scope, CoveredFromSequence: 1, CoveredThroughSequence: 10,
		DigestFromSequence: 1, DigestThroughSequence: 10, DigestEventSequence: 10,
		SourceDigest: digestDialogMessages(dialog.Messages[:10]), Payload: large,
		SchemaCode: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion,
		Revision: 1, CreatedAt: now.Add(-time.Hour), UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{scope: stored}}
	result, err := (ContextBuilder{Summaries: store}).Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, result.ProvisionalSummary)
	require.True(t, result.Messages[len(result.Messages)-1].IsSource)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.LessOrEqual(t, len(encoded), domain.TeacherContextMaximumBytes)
	require.LessOrEqual(t, utf8.RuneCount(encoded), domain.TeacherContextMaximumRunes)
}

func TestContextBuilderInvalidatesVisibleEditedRangeAndRebuildsWithNewFence(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}}
	summarizer := &contextSummarizer{}
	builder := ContextBuilder{Summaries: store, Summarizer: summarizer}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 32)
	_, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	firstKey := summarizer.requests[0].IdempotencyKey

	dialog.Messages[4].Body = "edited public message"
	dialog.Messages[4].LastEventSequence += 100
	appendSourceMessage(&dialog, 26, 32)
	result, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.invalidations)
	require.Len(t, summarizer.requests, 2)
	require.NotEqual(t, firstKey, summarizer.requests[1].IdempotencyKey)
	require.Equal(t, int64(14), result.ProvisionalSummary.CoveredThroughSequence)
	stored := store.items[resultScope(dialog)]
	require.Equal(t, int64(105), stored.DigestEventSequence, "summary fence must use the maximum visible mutation sequence")
}

func TestContextBuilderInvalidatesVisibleDeletedRangeAndRebuilds(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextSummaryStore{items: map[domain.TeacherContextScope]domain.TeacherContextSummary{}}
	summarizer := &contextSummarizer{}
	builder := ContextBuilder{Summaries: store, Summarizer: summarizer}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	dialog := dialogContextWithMessages(25, 32)
	_, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	dialog.Messages[4].Body = ""
	dialog.Messages[4].Status = 2
	dialog.Messages[4].LastEventSequence += 100
	appendSourceMessage(&dialog, 26, 32)
	result, err := builder.Build(context.Background(), dialog, "ru", now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, store.invalidations)
	require.Len(t, summarizer.requests, 2)
	require.NotNil(t, result.ProvisionalSummary)
	for _, message := range summarizer.requests[1].Messages {
		require.NotEqual(t, int64(5), message.MessageSequence)
	}
}

func TestSummaryIdempotencyAndScopeAreExact(t *testing.T) {
	base := domain.TeacherContextScope{
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
		ContextID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
	}
	require.Equal(t, summaryIdempotencyKey(base, 20), summaryIdempotencyKey(base, 20))
	otherPath := base
	otherPath.ContextID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	require.NotEqual(t, summaryIdempotencyKey(base, 20), summaryIdempotencyKey(otherPath, 20))
	otherMode := base
	otherMode.ContextType = domain.LearningContextPracticeTask
	require.NotEqual(t, summaryIdempotencyKey(base, 20), summaryIdempotencyKey(otherMode, 20))
	require.NotEqual(t, summaryIdempotencyKey(base, 20), summaryIdempotencyKey(base, 21))
}

func dialogContextWithMessages(count, bodyRunes int) domain.DialogRequestContext {
	const (
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	)
	messages := make([]domain.DialogMessage, 0, count)
	for sequence := 1; sequence <= count; sequence++ {
		author := domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher
		senderID, personalTeacherID := "", teacherID
		if sequence%2 == 1 || sequence == count {
			author, senderID, personalTeacherID = domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, studentID, ""
		}
		messages = append(messages, domain.DialogMessage{
			ID: fmt.Sprintf("00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d", sequence), DialogID: dialogID,
			AuthorType: author, SenderID: senderID, PersonalTeacherID: personalTeacherID,
			Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, Body: strings.Repeat("a", bodyRunes), Status: 1,
			MessageSequence: int64(sequence), LastEventSequence: int64(sequence),
			CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 9, 0, sequence, 0, time.UTC),
		})
	}
	return domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID,
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral, SourceMessageID: messages[len(messages)-1].ID,
		Messages: messages,
	}
}

func appendSourceMessage(dialog *domain.DialogRequestContext, sequence, bodyRunes int) {
	message := domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: fmt.Sprintf("00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d", sequence), DialogID: dialog.DialogID,
		AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, SenderID: dialog.StudentID, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb,
		Body: strings.Repeat("b", bodyRunes), Status: 1, MessageSequence: int64(sequence), LastEventSequence: int64(sequence + 100),
		CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	dialog.Messages = append(dialog.Messages, message)
	dialog.SourceMessageID = message.ID
}

func summaryPayloadForContext() domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload {
	return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{
		Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: "bounded summary",
		UnderstoodObservations: []string{}, OpenDifficulties: []string{},
		AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{},
	}
}

func resultScope(dialog domain.DialogRequestContext) domain.TeacherContextScope {
	return domain.TeacherContextScope{
		StudentID: dialog.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: dialog.PersonalTeacherID,
		DialogID: dialog.DialogID, ContextType: dialog.ContextType, ContextID: dialog.ContextID,
	}
}

func combinedMessageBytes(messages []domain.TeacherContextMessage) int {
	total := 0
	for _, message := range messages {
		total += len(message.Body)
	}
	return total
}

func repeatedSummaryItems() []string {
	result := make([]string, 8)
	for index := range result {
		result[index] = strings.Repeat("я", 500)
	}
	return result
}
